service: user-events-service

plugins:
  - serverless-localstack
  - serverless-python-requirements        
custom:
  pythonRequirements:
    dockerizePip: true
    slim: true
    dockerImage: public.ecr.aws/sam/build-python3.11:latest-arm64
    fileName: requirements.txt
  localstack:
    stages:
      - local
    host: http://localhost
    edgePort: 4566
    autostart: true

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.11
  region: us-east-1
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  architecture: arm64

  environment:
    TABLE_NAME: users_events
    QUEUE_URL:
      Ref: UserEventsQueue
    EVENT_BUS_NAME: user-events-bus
    LOCALSTACK_URL: http://host.docker.internal:4566   

  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
          Resource:
            - !GetAtt UsersTable.Arn
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - events:PutEvents
          Resource:
            - !GetAtt UserEventsBus.Arn

package:                                        
  patterns:
    - "!node_modules/**"
    - "!.venv/**"
    - "!__pycache__/**"
    - "!*.pyc"
    - "!.build/**"
    - common/**
    - create_user/**
    - get_user/**
    - delete_user/**
    - process_user/**
    - update_user/**
    - main.py

functions:
  api:
    handler: main.handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /
          method: any
          cors: true
      - http:
          path: /{proxy+}
          method: any
          cors: true
  processUserUpdate:
    handler: process_user/handler.lambda_handler
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn:
            Fn::GetAtt:
              - UserEventsQueue
              - Arn
          batchSize: 5

resources:
  Resources:
    UserEventsBus:
      Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
      Properties:
        Name: user-events-bus

    UserEventsQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        QueueName: UserEventsQueue

    UserUpdatedEventRule:
      Type: AWS::Events::Rule
      Properties:
        Name: UserUpdatedToSQS
        EventBusName:
          Ref: UserEventsBus
        EventPattern:
          source:
            - user.service
          detail-type:
            - UserUpdated
        Targets:
          - Arn:
              Fn::GetAtt:
                - UserEventsQueue
                - Arn
            Id: "UserEventsQueueTarget"

    UsersTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: users_events
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: userId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: userId
            KeyType: HASH
